title: Slats bent/terrible quality
text: Slats bent/terrible quality. Supposed to hold 3000 lbs, 2 of the slats bent already and i slept on it 3 nights only so far. They sent replacement parts and i had to buy a big sheet of plywood but my 155 lb husband shakes the whole "3000lb capacity" bed frame and it creaks badly. I'm heavier and cant get any rest on it i lay in one spot. Very uneasy even though i have extra support. Run from this product. I wipl be throwing out this $140 bed frame after only having it a month. The search continues for a sturdy bed frame
